summary: VEILFALL: Ashes of the Nine is an isometric action RPG whose Bearers explore the shared Z01 road and its chapters, with a solo Veil stage for menus. The main-place referee advances quests and encounters; player, enemy and boss scripts own live combat, character.js persists Bearers, and shared data/loot/trade/brew modules connect combat to the Wayside Fire services.
places: places/main/ - shared Z01 adventure; sim.js owns quest chapters, NPCs, pack/boss lifecycle, rewards, progression and room sound/music.

places/main/cells/ - five authored cells span the Wayside Fire, Broken Lantern Road, Abbey/Crypt and Bone Stair/Ossuary, Fen/Lanternmere and Gallows Orchard; x0z0.scene holds Forge, Pilgrims' Board, Trophy Post and cauldron.
places/main/cells/x0z-2.scene - Bell Crypt approach and the Ossuary of Saint Ysolde: Bone Stair arches, skull-niche walls, columns, piles, cold braziers and reliquary dais using oss-kit.js.
places/main/config.yaml - main terrain, atmosphere, vegetation, arrival budget and reverb.
places/veil/ - ephemeral solo Lantern Shrine menu stage; the hidden menu body is parked here.
places/veil/cells/, config.yaml and sim.js - authored shrine/ravine environment and spawn; menu ambience, shrine hum and distant bell.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Wayside Fire services and board/trophy props; their scripts read and display persistent/shared state.
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry: main default, player/camera templates, lighting, arrival, nametag, desktop/touch actions and audio mix.
templates/player.js - Bladewraith body with humanoid-locomotion.js and scripts/player.js, plus carried-light child.
templates/camera.js - custom camera template running scripts/camera.js.
places/main/sim.js - Z01 referee for quests, Maelin/Ledd, packs, progression, boss spawning/reset and soundscape.
places/main/cells/ - authored playable road/chapter terrain; x0z-2.scene places the Ossuary, reached west/down from the Bell Crypt.
places/veil/cells/ and places/veil/config.yaml - solo menu-stage shrine/ravine and its environment.
scripts/arrival.js - world doorway behavior; saves an active Bearer leaving main.
shared: scripts/lib/character.js - Bearer schema, fresh state, realm roster/create/load/save/delete and packed position; player and arrival reuse it, crier and board-notes use realmOf.
scripts/db.js and scripts/lib/data/realms.yml - character and realm-bound trades table schemas plus realm routing/name registry.
scripts/lib/data/economy.yml and scripts/lib/coins.js - copper denominations, drops, rewards, sell values and stock used by sim, combat, shop, HUD and crier.
scripts/lib/data/combat.yml - hero, skill, enemy and boss tuning consumed by player, wax-pack and boss scripts.
scripts/lib/data/loot.yml, loot-icons.yml and scripts/lib/loot.js - gear/drop/forge rules, rolls, smith ranks, boss marks, crafting and gear stats for combat, pack UI and trade.
scripts/lib/data/brews.yml and scripts/lib/brews.js - brew recipes, costs, rank scaling and active-brew helpers used by player, HUD and pack UI.
scripts/lib/data/trade.yml and scripts/lib/trade.js - board tuning and realm listing/buy/unlist/collection logic; player routes actions here, crier and board-notes read listings.
scripts/lib/data/veilfall-map.js - shared floor gates, chapter areas and landmarks consumed by terrain, player and main sim.
notableExports: scripts/player.js - onSpawn, onInput, update; scripts/ui.js - default HUD/menu renderer; ui/nametag.js - default nametag renderer.
scripts/abbess.js, bailiff.js, ringer.js, warden.js and hangman.js - boss onSpawn/update handlers; abbess.js owns Ossuary Abbess combat.
scripts/crier.js - onSpawn, quiet, update; scripts/board-notes.js and trophies.js - update; scripts/wax-pack.js - roll, telegraph, hurtPlayers, payout, update.
scripts/gen/oss-kit.js - skull, geometry; scripts/gen/hub-trophy.js - HOOKS, geometry, collider.
scripts/lib/loot.js - SLOTS, TIER, icon, BAG, rollItem, FORGE, gearStats, mitigation, freeReforges, MARKS, markBoss, applyMark, craft and smith helpers.
scripts/lib/character.js - CHAR_KEYS, fresh, START, realmOf, pack, zoneOf, rollName, roster, create, load, save, remove; scripts/lib/brews.js - BREW and brew/rank helpers.

scripts/lib/shop.js and shop-ui.js - owned/shopInput and shopPanel; scripts/lib/trade.js and board-ui.js - TRADE, asks, readBoard, tradeInput and boardPanel; scripts/lib/pack-ui.js - PACK_CSS, packPanel.
ownership: scripts/lib/character.js CHAR_KEYS - persistent Bearer fields including quest/reward claims, boss flags, inv/gear/dust/gearLife/freeUsed, smithXp, renderXp, brew, heartwax and abbesswax.

scripts/player.js - active-body movement, combat, death/i-frame and skill timers, menu/options scratch, per-Bearer floor gates, inventory/service actions and derived gear stats; proximity flags and derived gs are transient.
places/main/sim.js - per-player quest/dialog/cut progression and reward claims; enemy pack/encounter spawning, boss lifecycle, room music and ambience.
scripts/wax-pack.js - ordinary enemy AI/hp/death and eligible Bearers' XP, copper, kills, shards and gear-drop inboxes.
scripts/bailiff.js, ringer.js, warden.js, hangman.js and abbess.js - respective boss hp/phases/casts/adds/defeat; participant flags, place boss rows and place.state.lastFall.
Boss scripts - first room-wide world.state.trophies[boss] record {at, by}; trophies.js derives relic visibility/plaque text and transient ring/flash dedupe.
scripts/crier.js - Brother Ledd's route, pause, sale/mark/fall announcement cursors; scripts/board-notes.js owns transient board refresh and parchment props.
scripts/lib/shop.js and scripts/lib/trade.js - shop/buyer state mutations and realm SQL trade rows respectively.
flows: world.config.yaml attaches player through templates/player.js and maps actions; UI menu actions → player.js routes title/realm/character/create/enter/logout/options.
player.js menuInput → character.js roster/create/load/remove; realms.yml maps selected realm to room and Bearer fields hydrate player.state.
While player.state.menu is set, player.js hides the body and moves it to solo place veil; menu screens remain state-driven and that place has no characters.

controls.js selects menu touch surface when player/charId is absent or menu active and while shop/bag is open; otherwise world.config.yaml supplies world controls; ui.js actions return to player.js and service handlers.
player.js periodically/on rest saves changed CHAR_KEYS plus packed position → character.js writes characters; arrival.js saves an active Bearer leaving main.
player.js derives chapter floor gates from quest stage/abbeyOpenAll → veilfall-map.js floorDist governs goals and movement; Ossuary floor requires stage 23 or open-all plus Abbey/Nave access.
Main sim advances quests and spawns/resets bosses; boss defeats mark participants and write place.state.lastFall {boss, by, at} → crier heralds a fresh fall to a nearby camp listener.

Stage 23 + entry into OSSUARY → main sim spawns Abbess at RELIQUARY; abbess.js publishes place.state.abbess for ui.js boss bar, fights with ring/line casts and adds, then sets abbessKilled and awards heartwax/Abbess Candle to present Bearers.
Boss scripts write first room-wide world.state.trophies[boss] = {at, by} → trophies.js updates Trophy Post relic/plaque and ui/nametag.js marks Firstblood; crier announces fresh falls and worn marks.
Firstblood names in trophies → loot.js freeReforges versus persistent freeUsed; player.js applies earned marks chronologically to items and derives gear stats.

Near wayside-forge, pack-ui craft/temper/reforge/ascend → player.js + loot.js consume materials, award smithXp and update inventory/gear; near cauldron, brew action consumes recipe resources, saves timed brew/renderXp and derives combat bonuses.
Pilgrims' Board UI → player.js/trade.js performs guarded realm listing/buy/unlist/collection; board-notes renders open notices, crier reads sales, and shop-ui/player routes vendor purchases.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/hub-*.js - reusable Wayside Fire props varied by instance params, seed and scene transform; share hub-kit.js, including forge, board, trophy and cauldron.
scripts/gen/vf-*.js other than vf-ruin.js - Broken Lantern Road landmarks/clutter varied by params and seeds, built with vf-kit.js.
scripts/gen/vf-ruin.js - road, arena, Wax Veil approach, ashlar, braziers and Abbey door forms selected by kind/dimensions and seed.
scripts/gen/veil-land.js and veil-shrine.js - Veil ledge/cliff/ridge structures vary by kind/dimensions; shrine exports structure/hook constants.
scripts/gen/arena-floor.js, arena-pillar.js, gibbet.js and toll-throne.js - Bailiff arena dressing sharing scripts/gen/shapes.js and its wax palette.
scripts/gen/abbey-litter.js and abbey-court.js - Abbey yard/Crypt litter and court dressing; kind/seed/transform vary litter, court keeps a clear local -Z door path.
scripts/gen/fen-*.js - Fen paths, heart, waystones, trees, stumps and dressing share fen-kit.js and vary by params, seed and transform.

scripts/gen/orch-kit.js with orch-gallows.js, orch-gibbet.js, orch-hanged.js, orch-tree.js and orch-props.js - Orchard gallows, boundary, dead trees and litter vary by kind/params/seed/transform; scripts/gen/oss-kit.js similarly makes Ossuary wall, column, pile, arch and dais forms.
probableOrphans: scripts/gen/wax-figure.js - legacy procedural enemy-figure generator; current wax actors use CDN models.
migrationNotes: Persistent character data is scripts/lib/character.js CHAR_KEYS plus packed position; boss kills/resources such as heartwax and abbesswax persist, while derived gs, lootIn and service proximity flags are transient.

Character rows are caller-owned and realm-bound; character.js scopes roster/load/save by owner and realm, while live names are unique per realm. realms.yml room IDs are routing identities, not places in this tree.
The Veil is solo and ephemeral and parks the hidden menu body at its origin; camera.js menu framing is tuned to its shrine/ledge, while character selection can affect showcase styling.

The jukebox is room-shared: main sim chooses mood from live Bearers' area majority and boss/fight overrides; Veil sim plays menu theme when no eligible Bearer is on main. Main reverb and bus gains are configured separately.

Boss state is distinct from ordinary enemy hp: each boss publishes a place.state row and marks participants; main sim owns spawning and quest progression/reset. Boss first-fall world.state.trophies is permanent per room, distinct from transient place.state.lastFall heralding.

Boss marks/free reforges depend on trophy slayer names and timestamps, while freeUsed is per character; Ossuary floor gating uses Bone Stair/Ossuary coordinates and depends on the chapter gate, so keep veilfall-map.js and player.js gate arguments aligned.
